name: 5-HO-DiPT
summary: 5-HO-DiPT, also known as 5-hydroxy-N,N-di-iso-propyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist. It is primarily known as a metabolite of the better known psychoactive drug 5-MeO-DiPT, but 5-HO-DiPT has also rarely been encountered as a designer drug in its own right.

pharmacology.text: 5-HO-DiPT, also known as 5-hydroxy-N,N-di-iso-propyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a serotonin receptor agonist. Tests in vitro show 5-HO-DiPT to have high serotonin 5-HT2A receptor affinity and good selectivity over the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor, while being more lipophilic than the related drug bufotenine (5-HO-DMT), which produces primarily peripheral effects.

uses.text: It is primarily known as a metabolite of the better known psychoactive drug 5-MeO-DiPT, but 5-HO-DiPT has also rarely been encountered as a designer drug in its own right.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It is mainly known as one of the compounds the body makes when it breaks down 5-MeO-DiPT, by stripping the methyl group off the oxygen.
fact.zh: 它主要以5-MeO-DiPT代謝產物的身分為人所知；身體會把氧上的甲基移除而生成它。
fact.zhHans: 它主要以5-MeO-DiPT代谢产物的身分为人所知；身体会把氧上的甲基移除而生成它。
